notes: No option matches. Exact answer 118/1326 = 59/663 (brute-forced over all 1326 pairs). working: Treating same-colour balls as identical, the 3 black positions are C(10,3) = 120 equally likely sets. No two adjacent means the blacks occupy 3 of the 8 gaps around 7 whites: C(8,3) = 56. P = 56/120 = 7/15. Brute-forced over all 120 position triples: 56 have no two consecutive.

working: If the combined series is the term-by-term product of n series of m values each, its GM is (prod_j prod_i x_ij)^(1/m) = prod_i (prod_j x_ij)^(1/m) = G1 G2 ... Gn, so G = G1 G2 ... Gn. Verified numerically on 4 random series of 5 positive values: G / (G1 G2 G3 G4) = 1 to 15 digits.

working: Sum of frequencies = 1+2+...+n = n(n+1)/2. For the k-th value x = k/(k+1) with f = k, f/x = k(k+1)/k = k+1, so sum f/x = sum_{k=1..n}(k+1) = n(n+3)/2. Hence HM = [n(n+1)/2]/[n(n+3)/2] = (n+1)/(n+3). Checked directly for n = 2,3,4,5,10 (3/5, 2/3, 5/7, 3/4, 11/13).
